title: Great buy
text: Great buy. These are a great buy, easy to clean, to store and the price was good too.  I intend on buying more as stocking stuffers because I use these almost everyday in my own kitchen.  They hold up well too.

product_metadata.title: William Bounds Set of Four Silicone Measuring Cups
features: Set of four ( (1 Cup, 1/2 Cup, 1/3 Cup, 1/4 Cup )
description: William Bounds set of measuring cups is the last set you’ll ever need. Made from metal and silicone they are durable and easy to keep clean, and they come on one ring so that you never lose them. Sili measuring cups are made of heat resistant silicone with stainless steel handles. Set comes with 4 cups: 1 cup, 1/2 cup, 1/3 cup, 1/4 cup. Cups are color coded for easy identification of size. Dishwasher safe.
